story: Jacksonport State Park is a 164.7-acre Arkansas state park in Jackson County, Arkansas in the United States. It contains the 1872 Jacksonport courthouse and offers 20 campsites, a playground, a pavilion, a swimming beach along the White River and the Tunstall Riverwalk Trail.
matters: The park preserves historical sites including the 1872 Jacksonport courthouse which served as the home of county government from 1872-1892, and features connections to the American Civil War.
name: Jacksonport State Park
